scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0140; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘Ask about the time.’ and ‘Ask about the room too.’ are natural affirmative imperatives; legacy review sentences ‘I know this book.’, ‘I make coffee.’ and ‘This work takes a day.’ are also natural bounded A1 uses.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: ask is consistently represented as «پرسیدن» and the reviewed know/make/work/day meanings remain bounded to their previously taught Persian senses.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Target and legacy-review English distractors are grammatical, natural and contrastive, with explicit model audits and lesson-specific Persian feedback.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: One new spoken verb plus short recognition review of four familiar legacy items keeps the end-of-wave load controlled for A1.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The target changes the object of inquiry from time to room, while A09-A11 independently retrieve old language rather than merely repeating the current dialogue.

overallCoherence.evidence: The information-seeking scenario remains focused on ask, and the final review block provides an explicit end-of-wave spaced-retrieval function without changing target sense.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No visual claim exists; listening sources are audioRequired turns already exposed in A02, while A09-A11 require no unavailable media.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only ask meaning inquire about is assessed as the new target.

Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
